name: torch215-cu126-sm61-r3
notes: Pascal compilation uses CUDA12.6. CUDA13 CUPTI is a separate experimental runtime probe, not an automatic compiler upgrade.
CPU quantization, sparse-Lt, FlashAttention, MKLDNN, TensorPipe and optional vendor backends are disabled in this focused training build.
This explicit source-wheel route is independent of the existing 2.14 Bazel release actions.
Includes CUDA NVML development headers; no NVIDIA driver or NVML runtime replacement.

source_edits.reason: Avoid GCC12 -Wrestrict false positive for literal + rvalue string; equivalent braces emitted by existing fmt library, keeps all -Werror checks.
